plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INT4): integrations/grok-bot/ and the xAI API example
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Hosted bots (Grok Bot, the xAI API) cannot run a process next to Overdeck, so they need a ready plugin and a working API example that reach Overdeck through the opt-in public /mcp with OAuth. integrations/grok-bot/ holds only the skill copy today, and the Connect a bot dialog's xAI snippet uses a model xAI no longer lists and omits the required server_label.
narratives.Proposal: Ship integrations/grok-bot/ as a Cursor-format plugin (manifest, mcp.json with the dialog's placeholder URL, the shared skill, LICENSE), runnable dependency-free xAI Responses API examples in TypeScript and Python tested against a local fake xAI server, a README that embeds the dialog snippets verbatim, PUBLISHING and CHANGELOG, and a docs/verification.md that records CP-8. Fix botSnippets.xaiExample first. Add a pointer in configuration/mcp.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Running CP-8 live, turning Public MCP on, running tailscale, or calling api.x.ai from the work agent.
- Any change under src/dashboard/server/ or src/lib/, including the SSE fallback for routes/mcp.ts and widening bearerToken().
- Publishing the plugin to any catalog or registry.
- A plugin logo asset.
- configuration/bots.mdx, docs.json changes, and the stale <Info> block in configuration/mcp.mdx (W-DOC).
- CI workflow changes (W-CI1).
- Hooks or answer commands in the Grok Bot plugin; connector or Tailscale reach for Grok Bot.
- Changing any botSnippets.ts function other than xaiExample.

autoDecisions.summary: This issue fixes botSnippets.xaiExample (model grok-4.7, add server_label) instead of copying the stale snippet into the README.
autoDecisions.rationale: W-BOT1 is merged, the README must match the snippet, and xAI docs (2026-11-04) make server_label required and do not list grok-4; the xAI item owns its example.

autoDecisions.summary: The examples pass the bare access token in the xAI `authorization` field; CP-8c checks it live with "Bearer <token>" as the documented fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: xAI documents the field as the token it sets in the Authorization header (OpenAI Responses semantics); widening Overdeck bearerToken() is an auth-boundary change outside this item.

autoDecisions.summary: Both examples use raw REST with no SDK: Node built-in fetch and the Python standard library.
autoDecisions.rationale: One request shape to verify, no install step, and the xAI Python SDK spells two fields differently.

autoDecisions.summary: The work agent records CP-8 as "Not run: <reason>" with operator steps and does not run it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The host has no tailscale CLI and no XAI_API_KEY, and turning Public MCP on publishes a sign-in page to the internet, which is the operator's call; epic AC-28 allows CP-8 to record why.

autoDecisions.summary: No logo in plugin.json; PUBLISHING.md lists adding one before submission.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo has no PNG plugin logo and the epic W-INT4 step 1 does not list the key.

autoDecisions.summary: Each example has its own test file with its own fake server, so the two example items can run in parallel.
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids a shared-file edge between the TypeScript and Python items.

autoDecisions.summary: The package secret scan reads files by a directory walk, and the example tests run the scripts instead of reading them.
autoDecisions.rationale: lint:source-introspection fails any new test whose readFile call contains a .ts string literal.

autoDecisions.summary: Runnable examples accept XAI_BASE_URL (default https://api.x.ai/v1) and XAI_MODEL (default grok-4.7).
autoDecisions.rationale: Lets the tests use a local fake server and lets users follow xAI model changes without editing code.

items.title: Correct the xAI snippet in botSnippets.ts (model grok-4.7, server_label overdeck)

In botSnippets.ts add exported constants XAI_DEFAULT_MODEL = "grok-4.7" and XAI_SERVER_LABEL = "overdeck" after XAI_ALLOWED_TOOLS; in xaiExample replace the line `model: "grok-4",` with the constant and add `server_label: "overdeck",` directly after the server_url line. botSnippets.ts exports XAI_DEFAULT_MODEL equal to "grok-4.7" and XAI_SERVER_LABEL equal to "overdeck", and every other exported function returns the same text as before.

The mcp.json text equals grokBotMcpJson({ url: "https://YOUR-MACHINE.YOUR-TAILNET.ts.net:8443/mcp" }) plus a newline and contains exactly one server whose url starts with https:// and ends with :8443/mcp.

npm run lint passes with the new test file, so lint:source-introspection reports no new offender.
Runnable xAI Responses API example in TypeScript with a fake-server test

expected_outputs: running the example with no variables exits 2

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Write integrations/grok-bot/examples/xai-api.ts to the behavior contract in the PRD: env-only secrets (XAI_API_KEY, OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN, OVERDECK_MCP_URL, optional XAI_MODEL default grok-4.7 and XAI_BASE_URL default https://api.x.ai/v1), https-only MCP URL, one POST to <base>/responses with the exact mcp tool body including server_label "overdeck", redaction of both secrets in all output, exit codes 0/1/2. No import statements, no top-level await (async function main). Write grok-bot-example-ts.test.ts that runs the script with promisified execFile (never spawnSync, hazard H-2) against an in-process node:http fake xAI server for the four PRD cases.

items.title: When the fake xAI server answers 200 with an output_text item, the example exits 0, prints that text, and sends one POST /v1/responses whose tools array deep-equals the PRD body with server_label XAI_SERVER_LABEL, model XAI_DEFAULT_MODEL and allowed_tools XAI_ALLOWED_TOOLS.
When the fake server answers 401 with a body that echoes both secrets, the example exits 1 and prints `xAI API answered 401` with `[redacted]`, and stdout and stderr contain neither secret.
When OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN is unset, or OVERDECK_MCP_URL starts with http://, the example exits 2 with the PRD message and the fake server receives 0 requests.
Runnable xAI Responses API example in Python (stdlib only) with a fake-server test

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Write integrations/grok-bot/examples/xai-api.py with the same behavior contract as the TypeScript example, using only json, os, sys, urllib.error and urllib.request, valid on Python 3.9+, with a User-Agent header overdeck-grok-bot-example/0.1.0. Write grok-bot-example-py.test.ts that runs python3 on the script with promisified execFile and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 against an in-process fake xAI server for the same four cases. No skip when python3 is absent. Never commit __pycache__.

items.title: When the fake xAI server answers 200 with an output_text item, the Python example exits 0, prints that text, and sends the same request body the TypeScript example sends.
When the fake server answers 401 echoing both secrets, the Python example exits 1 and its output contains `[redacted]` and neither secret.
When a required variable is missing or OVERDECK_MCP_URL is not https, the Python example exits 2 and the fake server receives 0 requests.
git status shows no __pycache__ directory under integrations/grok-bot after the test run.
